board: Keyestudio Electromagnet Module KS0320 (P20/15 holding magnet, 4-pin header GND, VCC, NC, SIG)
reason: Modelled as an active-high actuator on SIG (on-board transistor switch and flyback diode, 5 V coil supply at up to about 0.4 A) using the Keyestudio KS0320 wiki pinout image and the ZYE1-P20/15 magnet datasheet. Part check PASS on ESP32 and Pico (sim on/off test, DRC clean). No driver needed (plain GPIO/PWM).
